findings.title: Lease rollback discards unrelated working-tree changes
findings.retires: Closes the unsafe implementation of “resets its own marker commit”; rollback must remove only the losing marker commit without destroying operator work.
findings.severity: Blocking when a lease push loses or is refused while the checkout contains unrelated tracked modifications: `git reset --hard HEAD^` deletes those modifications.

findings.title: An uncommitted passing stage record can be treated as completed
findings.retires: Closes the gap in the required worker-held-copy state: every written-but-uncommitted build or verify record must read as running, or as a refusal after its heartbeat becomes stale.
findings.severity: Blocking when the uncommitted record has status `pass`: `drive_state` advances past that stage before `_uncommitted` checks it, allowing a review to start or the item to read ready before the worker commits and pushes the record.

findings.title: Recovery cannot construct a valid verify record
findings.retires: Closes recovery for dead or hung review workers, rather than only build workers.
findings.severity: Blocking when `owes-recovery` names a verify invocation: the generated record leaves required non-null `build_sha` and `build_record` fields unset, so schema validation refuses the recovery instead of writing and pushing `verify-NN.json`.

findings.title: A stage starts without a pushed lease when origin is absent
findings.retires: Closes the origin-less exception to the rule that only a successfully pushed marker authorizes a worker to start.
findings.severity: Blocking when the checkout has no `origin`: the marker is committed locally and a worker starts even though no marker was pushed, so another checkout has no lease fact preventing the same attempt from running.

findings.title: Pre-pass synchronization rebases local commits instead of only fast-forwarding
findings.retires: Closes divergence from the approved requirement that a pass fast-forward its working copy to the origin branch before reading.
findings.severity: Blocking when both the local branch and origin have advanced: the pass rewrites local commits with `git rebase FETCH_HEAD`, changing operator-authored commit identities before taking its lease.

findings.title: The worker entry point does not require the lease marker it claims to execute
findings.retires: Closes the bypass around the marker-push lease by requiring a worker invocation to correspond to an existing committed marker for the same stage and attempt.
findings.severity: Blocking when `attavo worker N <stage> NN` is invoked directly or with a mismatched attempt: it runs the stage without proving that this process owns a pushed marker, permitting duplicate or unleased execution.
